findings.source_quote: The true thy chartered freemen are / of every age and clime:
findings.suggested_fix: Translate "chartered freemen" as a phrase that conveys the legal/privileged status in conventional Swahili, e.g. "wanaopewa huru za kifungu/charter" or "wanaohifadhiwa kama raia walioteuliwa". A concise suggestion: "wao ni wenye haki za chombo kutoka kila umri na eneo:". Preserve the two-line stanza break and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: Wa kweli ni raia waliochaguliwa wako / wa kila umri na mkoa:

findings.source_quote: How gleam thy watch-fires through the night
findings.suggested_fix: "Watch-fires" refers to sentry/guard fires or beacon fires. Replace the current literal/awkward "Jivuni vako vya kuangalia" with an idiomatic rendering such as "Vituo vyako vya mwanga wa walinzi vinaangaza usiku" or "moto/mishumaa yako ya wachungaji yanaangaza usiku". Keep the stanza line structure and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: Jivuni vako vya kuangalia vinaangaza kupitia usiku

findings.suggested_fix: The phrase means "with an unfailing/undimmed light". Replace "miale isiyoyeyuka" (literally "non-melting rays") with a natural phrase such as "kwa mwanga usiozimika" or "kwa miale isiyozimika". Keep stanza breaks and tags.

The phrase means "drifting sands" (sands moved by wind/tide). "mtondo unaotembea kwa upepo" is incorrect. Use "mchanga unaotembea/unaorushwa na upepo" or "mchanga unaoelea". Example: "kwa bure mchanga unaotembea:". Preserve stanza and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: kwa bure mtondo unaotembea kwa upepo:
